sources.title: GLM (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Z.ai released GLM-5.3 on 14 August 2026 and made the model's weights available two weeks later. [9][10][11] Later that month, Z.ai anonymously previewed a model called Ox Alpha on OpenRouter, which was released with weights on 26 August as GLM-5.3-Flash.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It is a 320B Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters, built for coding, agentic work, and visual tasks, and released under the MIT License.
